notes: Independent exact recomputation of the reported n=20 graph gives |V|=40, 76 total Relax invocations, 75 successful Relax operations, and only 1 successful update of t, versus the claimed 2^(n-1)=524288 updates of t. Structurally, both children of a vertex receive the same candidate because an edge weight depends only on its tail. At each level, the bit-1 predecessor supplies the cheaper candidate and is queued before a worse child can be processed. Thus each intermediate child can improve at most twice, giving the family-wide upper bound 2+4(n-2)+1=4n-5 successful Relax operations; the checked bit-0-first execution attains this bound. The theorem's exponential lower bound and its target-only subsidiary claim are substantive claims, not typos the author plainly did not mean. The separate use of 2n vertices instead of exactly n also does not rescue an operation count linear in either parameter.
